title: Dropout in theory and in Pytorch

cues.en: Dropouts is a regularization technique that is often used when training deep learning models.
cues.zh: Dropout 是訓練深度學習模型時，常用的正則化技巧。

cues.en: It's quite simple, both in theory and in practice.
cues.zh: 理論與實務都很簡單。

cues.en: And in this video I will explain the concept of dropout and show you how it works in PyTorch.
cues.zh: 這支影片會解釋概念，展示 PyTorch 裡如何運作。

cues.en: And in the next code challenge, which is two videos from now, you will implement this in model five with some pre-training.
cues.zh: 下個程式挑戰，也就是再過兩支影片，會在模型五加入 dropout，做一些預訓練。

cues.en: So imagine this is a deep learning model that we want to train.
cues.zh: 想像這是要訓練的深度學習模型。

cues.en: Now this is not what an LLM looks like but this is just for illustration.
cues.zh: 不是 LLM 的樣子，只是示意。

cues.en: So the idea is that in the first training epoch some of the units in the model are randomly dropped.
cues.zh: 第一個訓練週期中，隨機丟棄模型的一些單元。

cues.en: Now when I say dropped, I mean that their activations are forced to be zero.
cues.zh: 所謂丟棄，是強制把活化值設為零。

cues.en: So doesn't matter what's coming into the unit, it doesn't matter what the values of the weights are.
cues.zh: 不論輸入是什麼、權重數值多少，

cues.en: Some of these units will just have their activation outputs switched off.
cues.zh: 某些單元的活化輸出，都會被關掉。

cues.en: So set to zero.
cues.zh: 也就是設為零。

cues.en: And then in the next training epoch some other units will have their activations switched to zero.
cues.zh: 下個訓練週期，換另一些單元的活化值設為零。

cues.en: So it's not always the same units.
cues.zh: 不是永遠相同的單元。

cues.en: In fact the idea of Dropbox is to assign a probability of dropping.
cues.zh: dropout 的概念，是指定丟棄機率。

cues.en: And at each iteration in training, each unit has a probability of being dropped or zeroed out.
cues.zh: 每次訓練迭代，每個單元都有機會被丟棄、歸零。

cues.en: So what does this do?
cues.zh: 作用是什麼？

cues.en: This forces the model to learn distributed representations and features throughout all of the units, instead of isolating what it's learned to one individual unit.
cues.zh: 迫使模型在所有單元中，學習分散的表徵與特徵，而非把學到的東西集中在單一單元。

cues.en: That is a good thing because it makes the model more robust and more stable.
cues.zh: 有好處，讓模型更穩健、穩定。

cues.en: It also helps the model generalize a bit better, especially if the sample data are all really similar to each other.
cues.zh: 也幫助泛化，尤其樣本彼此非常相似時。

cues.en: On the other hand, it also means that the total sum of activation has been reduced because of all of
cues.zh: 但也代表，被丟棄節點的活化值為零，

cues.en: the zero activations from the dropped out nodes, and that can have negative consequences for downstream calculations, including softmax.
cues.zh: 讓整體活化總量下降，可能不利於後續計算，包括 softmax。

cues.en: So dropout reduces the level of activation, and the two solutions to deal with this are either to scale
cues.zh: 因此 dropout 降低活化程度，有兩個解法：

cues.en: up the weights that are not dropped out during training, or you can scale down all of the weights during testing, evaluation, and deployment.
cues.zh: 訓練時放大未丟棄的權重，或者測試、評估、部署時，把所有權重縮小。

cues.en: I will show you what that looks like in PyTorch in a few minutes.
cues.zh: 幾分鐘後會展示 PyTorch 的樣子。

cues.en: Here is a screenshot of the paper that first introduced dropout.
cues.zh: 這是最初提出 dropout 的論文截圖。

cues.en: Way way, way back when in 2014.
cues.zh: 很久以前，2014 年。

cues.en: Here is a diagram from their paper and you can see looks basically the same as what I drew a few slides ago.
cues.zh: 這是論文示意圖，和我前幾張投影片畫的基本相同。

cues.en: The network is oriented differently, but these are just details.
cues.zh: 網路方向不同，但只是細節。

cues.en: Anyway, here you see an example of an error rate in a classification task.
cues.zh: 這是分類任務的錯誤率。

cues.en: And when they include dropout in that model the model actually does better.
cues.zh: 加入 dropout，模型表現確實較好。

cues.en: So lower classification accuracy means higher performance.
cues.zh: 所以分類準確率越低，表現越好。

cues.en: This is not in an LM by the way.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，這不是 LLM。

cues.en: This is a different kind of model.
cues.zh: 是另一種模型。

cues.en: Why does dropout work.
cues.zh: 為什麼 dropout 有效？

cues.en: What is it actually doing?
cues.zh: 到底做了什麼？

cues.en: The answer is nobody really knows for sure.
cues.zh: 沒有人真正確定。

cues.en: Like many things in deep learning, someone had the very smart intuition that this could be an interesting thing to do.
cues.zh: 和深度學習很多東西一樣，有人憑很聰明的直覺，覺得這也許值得試。

cues.en: And they tried it.
cues.zh: 於是試了。

cues.en: And empirically, it seems to work better sometimes for certain kinds of models and certain kinds of data sets.
cues.zh: 實驗上，對某些模型、資料集，有時效果較好。

cues.en: But anyway, the speculative idea is that dropout prevents any one unit in the network.
cues.zh: 但推測的概念是，避免任何單元，

cues.en: So any one neuron from carrying too much responsibility.
cues.zh: 任何神經元，承擔過多責任。

cues.en: And that's because if one unit can learn an entire rule, then the model performance will suffer whenever that unit is probabilistically turned off.
cues.zh: 如果一個單元能學完整條規則，那它隨機關閉時，模型表現就會受損。

cues.en: So that means that dropout forces the model to learn a more distributed feature representation and classification rules.
cues.zh: 因此 dropout 迫使模型學習更分散的特徵表徵、分類規則。

cues.en: Some other things to know about Dropbox.
cues.zh: 還有一些要知道的事。

cues.en: It does tend to decrease training accuracy, but it increases test accuracy and generalization performance,
cues.zh: 通常訓練準確率下降，但測試準確率、泛化表現提升，

cues.en: and it therefore tends to require more training data compared to models without dropout.
cues.zh: 因此往往比沒有 dropout 的模型，需要更多訓練資料。

cues.en: Dropout doesn't seem to work very well for small models.
cues.zh: 小模型似乎不太適合 dropout。

cues.en: It's really just something for very large and very deep models with lots of hidden layers.
cues.zh: 主要用於很大、很深、有很多隱藏層的模型。

cues.en: And of course that is the case for LMS.
cues.zh: LLM 當然如此。

cues.en: And so now let me tell you a little bit about how and when dropout is used in large language models.
cues.zh: 接著談大型語言模型如何、何時使用 dropout。

cues.en: Now in some sense are just the same as any other deep learning model with a few little, you know, subtle quirks here and there.
cues.zh: 某種程度上，和其他深度學習模型相同，只是有些小細節。

cues.en: But the data sets used for training LMS are so enormous and so diverse that LMS have a much lower risk
cues.zh: 但 LLM 訓練集極大、多樣，因此比起

cues.en: of overfitting compared to other kinds of models and other kinds of data sets.
cues.zh: 其他模型、資料集，過擬合風險低得多。

cues.en: And so that means that dropout is generally not as useful for LMS as it is for other deep learning models,
cues.zh: 所以一般不如其他深度學習模型那麼需要 dropout，

cues.en: for example, in computer vision.
cues.zh: 例如電腦視覺模型。

cues.en: In fact, if you studied deep learning before, you're probably used to seeing dropout probabilities of around 30% or 50%.
cues.zh: 之前學過深度學習，可能習慣看到 30% 或 50% 丟棄機率。

cues.en: That's fairly normal.
cues.zh: 很常見。

cues.en: In LMS, people use 10%, sometimes 5% or even 2% dropout.
cues.zh: LLM 則用 10%，有時 5%，甚至 2%。

cues.en: So it's a very gentle dropout.
cues.zh: 很輕微。

cues.en: Dropout can be applied at any stage of training an LLM, but it's less important during pre-training
cues.zh: 任何訓練階段都能用，但預訓練時較不重要，

cues.en: and more important during fine tuning and instruction tuning.
cues.zh: 微調、指令微調較重要。

cues.en: Now, I haven't really talked in detail about fine tuning.
cues.zh: 還沒詳細談微調。

cues.en: We'll get to that in the next section.
cues.zh: 下一節會介紹。

cues.en: But the basic reason is that the data for pre-training are already really big and diverse, and pre-training
cues.zh: 基本原因是，預訓練資料已經大而多樣，通常只

cues.en: models is done usually in just a couple of passes through the data set, maybe three repeats of the data set.
cues.zh: 遍歷幾次，也許重複三次。

cues.en: So the model never really sees the same data on a lot of occasions.
cues.zh: 模型不會反覆看相同資料很多次。

cues.en: That means that the model doesn't really have the opportunity for a lot of memorization.
cues.zh: 就不太有機會大量記憶。

cues.en: On the other hand, during fine tuning and instruction tuning, the data sets tend to be more limited
cues.zh: 另一方面，微調與指令微調資料較有限，

cues.en: and also more focused on a particular topic, and therefore the risk of overfitting is higher and therefore dropout becomes more useful.
cues.zh: 也更專注特定主題，所以過擬合風險較高，dropout 更有用。
